chunks: From him, from Harun ibn Hamzah al-Ghanawi, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the takbir in al-Fitr and al-Adha. He said: Five and four; so it does not harm you if you conclude upon an odd number.

key_terms.أَرْبَعٌ: four, referring here to the number of takbirs
key_terms.التَّكْبِيرِ: the utterance of Allahu akbar within the ritual prayer
key_terms.الْأَضْحَى: the Eid of sacrifice, meaning Eid al-Adha
key_terms.الْفِطْرِ: the Eid of breaking the fast, meaning Eid al-Fitr
key_terms.خَمْسٌ: five, referring here to the number of takbirs

ai.seo_question: How many takbirs are recited in the salat of Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the number of takbirs in the salat of the two 'Eids, al-Fitr and al-Adha. The Imam عليه السلام states numbers for them and indicates that concluding on an odd number is acceptable, showing flexibility within the ritual form.
